import pandas as pd

# Assuming DF is defined
outliers_iqr = {}

for col in DF.columns:
    Q1 = DF[col].quantile(0.25)
    Q3 = DF[col].quantile(0.75)
    IQR = Q3 - Q1
    # Define outliers
    lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
    upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
    outliers = DF[(DF[col] < lower_bound) | (DF[col] > upper_bound)]
    outliers_iqr[col] = outliers.index.tolist()
    print(f"{col}: {len(outliers)} outliers detected")

    plt.subplot(5, 3, i + 1)
    
    # Create the boxplot
    # The "dots" outside the whiskers are the detected outliers
    sns.boxplot(x=df_11[col], color='skyblue', flierprops={"marker": "x", "markerfacecolor": "red"})
    
    plt.title(f'Outliers in {col}', fontsize=12)
    plt.xlabel('Value')

# 3. Adjust layout to prevent overlapping titles
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("outlier_analysis.png")

----
def detect_outliers(df, cols):
    outliers = {}
    for col in cols:
        Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)
        Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
        IQR = Q3 - Q1
        lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
        upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
        outliers[col] = df[(df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)][col]
    return outliers

outliers = detect_outliers(df_11, target_cols)
for k,v in outliers.items():
    print(f"{k}: {len(v)} outliers")

import re

SMILES_REGEX = r"(\[[^\]]+\]|Br|Cl|@@?|=|#|\(|\)|\d+|[A-Za-z])"

def tokenize(smiles):
    return re.findall(SMILES_REGEX, smiles)

tokens = set()
for s in df_11["smiles"]:
    tokens.update(tokenize(s))

print("Vocabulary size:", len(tokens))

SMILES_REGEX = r"(\[[^\]]+\]|Br|Cl|@@?|=|#|\(|\)|\d+|[A-Za-z])"
print("SMILES REGEX:", SMILES_REGEX)

----


+*Out[40]:*+
----
SMILES REGEX: (\[[^\]]+\]|Br|Cl|@@?|=|#|\(|\)|\d+|[A-Za-z])
----


+*In[41]:*+
[source, ipython3]
----
def tokenize_smiles(smiles_list):
    return [re.findall(SMILES_REGEX, s) for s in smiles_list]

tokenized_smiles = tokenize_smiles(smiles_list)

----

[source, ipython3]

for i, (s, t) in enumerate(zip(smiles_list, tokenized_smiles)):
    print(f"SMILES {i}: {s}")
    print(f"Tokens    : {t}\n")

def encode_and_pad(tokenized):
    encoded = [[token2idx[t] for t in s] for s in tokenized]
    return encoded

encoded_smiles = encode_and_pad(tokenized_smiles)

# 5️⃣ TOKENIZE SMILES
SMILES_REGEX = r"(\[[^\]]+\]|Br|Cl|@@?|=|#|\(|\)|\d+|[A-Za-z])"
def tokenize_smiles(smiles_list):
    return [re.findall(SMILES_REGEX, s) for s in smiles_list]

tokenized_smiles = tokenize_smiles(smiles_list)
----


+*In[52]:*+
[source, ipython3]
----
print("SMILES REGEX:", SMILES_REGEX)
----


+*Out[52]:*+
----
SMILES REGEX: (\[[^\]]+\]|Br|Cl|@@?|=|#|\(|\)|\d+|[A-Za-z])
----


+*In[53]:*+
[source, ipython3]
----
# 6️⃣ BUILD VOCAB + PAD SEQUENCES
tokens = sorted(set(t for s in tokenized_smiles for t in s))
token2idx = {t: i+1 for i, t in enumerate(tokens)}
MAX_LEN = 27
EMBED_DIM = 64

def encode_and_pad(tokenized):
    encoded = [[token2idx[t] for t in s] for s in tokenized]
    return tf.keras.preprocessing.sequence.pad_sequences(encoded, maxlen=MAX_LEN, padding="post")

X_pad = encode_and_pad(tokenized_smiles)
vocab_size = len(token2idx) + 1
----

# 9️⃣ WEIGHTED MSE LOSS
def weighted_mse(y_true, y_pred):
    weights = K.constant(target_weights, dtype=tf.float32)
    se = K.square(y_true - y_pred)
    weighted_se = se * weights
    return K.mean(weighted_se, axis=-1)

# 🔟 UTILITY FUNCTIONS
def evaluate_per_target(y_true, y_pred):
    results = {}
    for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
        results[col] = {
            "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_true[:, i], y_pred[:, i]),
            "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true[:, i], y_pred[:, i])),
            "R2": r2_score(y_true[:, i], y_pred[:, i])
        }
    return results

def plot_learning_curve(history, model_name):
    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train Loss')
    plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Val Loss')
    plt.xlabel('Epochs')
    plt.ylabel('Weighted MSE Loss')
    plt.title(f'Learning Curve: {model_name}')
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()


def plot_scatter_per_target(y_true, y_pred):
    n = len(target_cols)
    plt.figure(figsize=(15,3*n))
    for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
        plt.subplot(n,1,i+1)
        plt.scatter(y_true[:,i], y_pred[:,i], alpha=0.6)
        plt.plot([y_true[:,i].min(), y_true[:,i].max()],
                 [y_true[:,i].min(), y_true[:,i].max()],
                 'r--')
        plt.xlabel("True")
        plt.ylabel("Pred")
        plt.title(f"{col} True vs Predicted")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

from tensorflow.keras.layers import Input

def build_lstm(units=64, dropout=0.2, embed_dim=64):
    model = Sequential([
        Input(shape=(MAX_LEN,), name="SMILES_Input"),
        Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, mask_zero=True, name="SMILES_Embedding"),
        LSTM(units, name="LSTM"),
        Dropout(dropout),
        Dense(32, activation="relu", kernel_regularizer=l2(1e-4), name="Dense_Features"),
        Dense(len(target_cols), activation="linear", name="MultiTarget_Output")
    ])
    model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss=weighted_mse)
    return model

----

def build_bilstm(units=64, dropout=0.2, embed_dim=64):
    model = Sequential([
        Input(shape=(MAX_LEN,), name="SMILES_Input"),
        Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, mask_zero=True, name="SMILES_Embedding"),
        Bidirectional(LSTM(units), name="BiLSTM"),
        Dropout(dropout),
        Dense(64, activation="relu", kernel_regularizer=l2(1e-4), name="Dense_Features"),
        Dense(len(target_cols), activation="linear", name="MultiTarget_Output")
    ])
    model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss=weighted_mse)
    return model

# 1️⃣2️⃣ BAYESIAN OPTIMIZATION + NESTED K-FOLD CV
def bayesian_opt_cv(model_type, X, Y, n_trials=10, epochs=12, k_folds=3):
    def objective(trial):
        units = trial.suggest_int("units", 64, 128)
        dropout = trial.suggest_float("dropout", 0.1, 0.5)
        lr = trial.suggest_float("lr", 1e-4, 1e-2, log=True)
        embed_dim = trial.suggest_int("embed_dim", 32, 64)

        kf = KFold(n_splits=k_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
        fold_rmse = []

        for train_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X):
            X_train_fold, X_val_fold = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
            Y_train_fold, Y_val_fold = Y[train_idx], Y[val_idx]

            if model_type=="LSTM": model = build_lstm(units, dropout, embed_dim)
            else: model = build_bilstm(units, dropout, embed_dim)

            
            model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=lr), loss=weighted_mse)


            batch_size = trial.suggest_categorical("batch_size", [32,64,128])

            model.fit(
                X_train_fold, Y_train_fold,
                validation_data=(X_val_fold, Y_val_fold),
                epochs=epochs,
                batch_size=batch_size,
                verbose=0,
                callbacks=[EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=2, restore_best_weights=True)]
            )

            preds = model.predict(X_val_fold)
            fold_rmse.append(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(Y_val_fold, preds)))

        return np.mean(fold_rmse)

    study = optuna.create_study(direction="minimize")
    study.optimize(objective, n_trials=n_trials)
    print(f"\nBest hyperparameters for {model_type}: {study.best_params}")
    return study, study.best_params

----
def train_final_model(model_type, best_params, X_train_val, Y_train_val, X_test, Y_test, epochs=100):
    if model_type=="LSTM":
        model = build_lstm(best_params['units'], best_params['dropout'], best_params['embed_dim'])
    else:
        model = build_bilstm(best_params['units'], best_params['dropout'], best_params['embed_dim'])

    checkpoint_path = f"best_model_{model_type}.h5"
    callbacks = [
        EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=10, restore_best_weights=True),
        ReduceLROnPlateau(monitor='val_loss', factor=0.5, patience=5),
        ModelCheckpoint(checkpoint_path, monitor='val_loss', save_best_only=True)
    ]

    history = model.fit(
        X_train_val, Y_train_val,
        validation_split=0.15,
        epochs=epochs,
        batch_size=best_params.get('batch_size', 64),
        callbacks=callbacks,
        verbose=1
    )

    plot_learning_curve(history, model_type)

    # Predict on hold-out test set
    preds_scaled = model.predict(X_test)
    preds = y_scaler.inverse_transform(preds_scaled)
    Y_test_true = y_scaler.inverse_transform(Y_test)

    metrics = evaluate_per_target(Y_test_true, preds)
    plot_scatter_per_target(Y_test_true, preds)

    print(f"\nPer-target metrics on hold-out test set for {model_type}:")
    for k,v in metrics.items():
        print(f"{k} → MAE: {v['MAE']:.3f}, RMSE: {v['RMSE']:.3f}, R²: {v['R2']:.3f}")

    return model, metrics

        Y_test,
        epochs=100
    )

    final_results[m] = metrics

def overall_r2(metrics_dict):
    """
    metrics_dict: output of evaluate_per_target()
    """
    r2_scores = [v['R2'] for v in metrics_dict.values()]
    return np.mean(r2_scores)

def overall_accuracy_percent(metrics_dict, Y_true):
    accuracies = []
    for i, (target, m) in enumerate(metrics_dict.items()):
        target_range = Y_true[:, i].max() - Y_true[:, i].min()
        acc = (1 - m['RMSE'] / target_range) * 100
        accuracies.append(acc)
    return np.mean(accuracies)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def plot_learning_curve(history, model_name):
    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train Loss')
    plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Validation Loss')
    plt.xlabel("Epoch")
    plt.ylabel("Loss")
    plt.title(f"Learning Curve – {model_name}")
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()
